meta.title: Vendor can bid only on the current active line item
gaps: Configure a live serial bidding auction with several line items and verify that bidding on a non-current line item is refused while bidding on the current line item succeeds.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Configure a live serial bidding auction with several line items and verify that bidding on a non-current line item is refused while bidding on the current line item succeeds.

steps.note: Create the multi-stage event screen needed for an auction with multiple line items.
Configure the event with an auction stage.
Move to the auction stage before configuring its template and sheet.
Create several line items so the active-line restriction could be exercised.
Invite the QA vendor needed for the vendor-side bidding check.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Open the vendor's auction bid sheet.

args.need: configure the auction as serial bidding, bid on the current active line item, then try to bid on a different line item and report that only the active line accepts bidding

steps.note: The catalog has no serial-bidding configuration or line-specific bid action.
Assert that the vendor pricing screen remains available after the tester's interaction.
